create_web_scraper.template:
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

def scrape(url):
    response = requests.get(url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    return soup

if __name__ == '__main__':
    result = scrape('https://example.com')
    print(result.title.text)
